entities.summary: Dali Jazi was a Tunisian politician, jurist, and political scientist. He studied at Panthéon-Assas University. He served variously as minister of defense, minister with responsibility for human rights, minister of health, and minister of higher education, under president Zine el-Abidine ben Ali.
